##### Project general facts

Mr. C Residences Downtown is a breathtakingly elegant branded residential development that embodies the revered Cipriani family's hospitality legacy, offering an extraordinary fusion of classic European flair and contemporary sophistication. Every residence within this stunning development is basked in an abundance of natural light and epitomizes Italian refinement, thus exuding an aura of effortless glamour and refined poise. The residences are meticulously crafted, with the refined Signature Collection comprises exquisite two- and three-bedroom homes, while the discerning Nobile Collection presents majestic four-bedroom residences, each one meticulously designed to deliver an unparalleled and unforgettable lifestyle experience.

The development boasts an exquisite array of premium, around-the-clock amenities that transform everyday living into an extraordinary experience. Residents can indulge in a wealth of sumptuous amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, a cutting-edge fitness centre equipped with state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, a serene yoga and pilates room, a technologically advanced golf simulator, and a holistic spa featuring an extensive range of wellness amenities, such as steam, sauna, salt room, oxygen room, and lavish treatment rooms. Additionally, a wide range of social and lifestyle spaces is available, including an elegantly appointed lobby lounge showcasing carefully curated art, the sophisticated Bellini Bar by Mr. C, a private cinema, an expansive residents' library, a dedicated events space, a business lounge, and the enchanting Little C's Kids Club.

The interiors of Mr. C Residences Downtown have been masterfully composed by 1508 London, blending understated sophistication with refined, design-forward elegance in every meticulously crafted home. Both the Signature and Nobile Collections showcase bespoke Italian kitchens that effortlessly combine form and function, featuring top-tier appliances and concertina doors that seamlessly open onto spacious dining and great rooms. The finest materials have been incorporated into these residences, including radiant Calacatta marble, high-end Gaggenau appliances, custom chandeliers, sumptuous Loro Piana fabrics, and principal bedrooms with bespoke Italian vanities and lavish, luxurious bathtubs that evoke the allure of a private sanctuary, thus redefining the essence of refined living.


##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai stands as the vibrant epicentre of Dubai, an area that is constantly evolving at a rapid pace, with a plethora of landmarks and world-famous attractions, including the majestic Burj Khalifa, the expansive Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dancing Fountains. The area is a bustling hub of activities, attracting a diverse range of people throughout the year. Downtown Dubai is renowned for offering a luxurious lifestyle, with a unique blend of vertical communities and elegant villas, thus providing an unparalleled living experience.

The prime location of Downtown Dubai ensures that the area remains bustling and vibrant throughout the year, with a constant influx of tourists and an array of exciting activities to engage in. The area is well-connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city, making it an ideal location for residents. Downtown Dubai is also strategically situated along the iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, bordering the bustling Business Bay and Al Wasl, thus providing effortless access to a wide range of amenities and attractions.

Downtown Dubai is widely regarded as one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses, offering an extraordinary quality of life and an unparalleled range of amenities, including upscale hotels, chic leisure destinations, and expansive shopping centres. The area is particularly popular among non-drivers and frequent travellers, thanks to its excellent connectivity and wide range of amenities. As a result, Downtown Dubai has become the ultimate hub of activity, a place where residents can experience the very best of Dubai's vibrant lifestyle, earning its reputation as the "centre of now".
